name: thesis-mcwm-budgeted-difference-v16-20261021
scope: Four new common-prefix days (two unchanged initializer seeds x stable/shock), up to36 fresh training pairs and24 new heldout states. Main day jobs perform bounded sequential subprocess collection of training branches; evaluation branches are separate. Existing v15 diagnostic targets remain read only and are not fitted.
selection: First jointly executable issue per line in each predefined window; never inspect truth/error for selection. Training nominal commands use seed-fixed balanced low/high. Heldout anchors retain nominal controller commands and are selected after actual final packet. Missing cells remain missing.
common_prefix: Each child replays its own new main-day native prefix, observed commands, past admitted paired feedback, saved predictions and packet receipts exactly through the selected issue. Prefix traces/cache/journals remain resident.
continuation: Main native clock pauses while two training children replay the available prefix and run300 frozen native seconds. Children replay earlier pair caches only, never recursively collect or use future labels; both siblings share the same external seed and nominal other-batch commands. Every training and evaluation suffix has zero policy/world/trust/readout updates and no future calibration.
endpoint_clock: Exact native300-second ledger window. Global and same-car endpoints retain their native event clocks; endpoints not observed by cutoff remain missing.
trust: Original action_model trust formula and eight policy/trust updates per packet unchanged; trained parameters follow the new budgeted data stream. Both difference readouts share this common flow and remain passive.
physical_covariate: Reuse fixed102source physical intervals. No extra unbudgeted target physical labels. The new endpoint models use only selected controlled bundles.

independent_confirmation.reason: Small passive difference-learning development comparison only.

candidate_deployment: not_enabled; both paired readouts are passive on one new common action_model trajectory
budget: 57 packets x5 outcomes=285/day. At most one available pair replaces2 ordinary slots in a packet, leaving3 ordinary; otherwise5 ordinary. Exclude its factual main-flow issue from the ordinary pool. Each paired action has one distinct negative label ID and a real native global transition; zero-duration rows still consume their label slot and supervise the300s response but are excluded from world/trust transition fitting by the original rule. Only admitted paired labels fit difference models.
feedback_release: A pair is unavailable before issue+300+30 seconds and before both native global endpoints complete+30; branch wall-clock completion never advances the main native clock or permits early training.
targets: Learn low-minus-high waiting/ride gains at exactly300 native seconds, normalized by1000, ridge1. Cost gain=2*waiting gain+ride gain. Full model uses route3+one observable headway-imbalance feature; comparator route3, no background or learned propensity. No v15 target/feature/lambda search.

compute_budget.replay: All child prefix seconds, replayed training labels and updates counted separately, not pooled as new labels.
compute_budget.preflight: One short day, two training children and two heldout branches separately reported.
